authorization_url.description: One-time OAuth authorization URL. It is not a client secret or refresh token.

account_label.description: Trimmed requested label. A relink preserves the existing account label at callback completion.

account_purpose.description: Canonical capability derived from the effective requested OAuth scopes.

relink.description: True when oauth_account_id bound this one-time OAuth state to an existing connected account.

scopes.description: Effective requested OAuth scopes. OAuth credentials are never returned.
